prompt: I'm checking our NEC spectra against ETABS for a site with Z=0.40, soil D, sierra. At very short periods codeSpectra returns a flat Sa = 1.1904 g all the way down to T=0, but Figura 3 in the norm clearly shows the curve ramping up from about 0.48 g at T=0 to the plateau. Looks like a bug in elastic_spectrum(). Can you fix it so the ascending branch is used?
assertions: Concludes the flat plateau from T=0 is intentional, not a bug
Explains that NEC-SE-DS restricts the ascending branch to dynamic analysis and to modes other than the fundamental
Cites NEC-SE-DS clause 3.3.1 or the corresponding provision text
Points at elastic_spectrum(include_ascending_branch=True) as the existing opt-in
Leaves the default behaviour of elastic_spectrum unchanged (include_ascending_branch still defaults to False)
Notes that enabling the ramp by default would under-estimate short-period design demand
